context: A father comes home late and chats with his wife
purpose: Wind down the evening; teach 帰宅/堂/呼ん/刺激/だり/うえ/起こし/矛盾

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おかえりなさい。今日は帰宅が遅かったね。
lines.en: Welcome home. You came home late today.
lines.style: warm wife greeting her tired husband

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、会議が長引いてね。
lines.style: weary husband exhaling after the day

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ごはん、食堂で温め直そうか。
lines.en: Shall I reheat dinner in the dining room?
lines.style: attentive wife offering quiet comfort, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 助かるよ。娘はもう寝た？
lines.en: That helps. Is our daughter asleep?
lines.style: grateful father checking on the kids

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さっき名前を呼んだけど、勉強中だって。
lines.en: I called her name earlier; she said she’s studying.
lines.style: informing wife relaying the small update

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 最近、いい刺激を受けてるみたいだな。
lines.en: Lately she seems to be getting good stimulation.
lines.style: pleased father noting his daughter’s growth

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 塾で友だちと、読んだり話し合ったりしてるみたい。
lines.en: At cram school she reads and discusses with friends.
lines.style: observant mother describing the routine, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よく考えたうえで進路を決めてほしいな。
lines.en: I hope she decides her path after thinking it through.
lines.style: thoughtful father expressing a gentle wish

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 朝は私が起こしてあげるわ。
lines.en: I’ll wake her in the morning.
lines.style: caring mother offering to handle it

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: でも言うことが日によって矛盾するんだよな、あの子。
lines.en: But what she says contradicts day to day, that kid.
lines.style: fondly exasperated father shaking his head
